title: Krown (exploratory desk try, not the pre-registered study): S5 MA cross, S8 squeeze break, S4 coil break, BTCUSDT or ETHUSDT: S5 4h target 2R fees 0.02/0.05% slip 0.02% 2022-04-01..2024-06-30

what.name: Study
what.value_plain: Krown (exploratory desk try, not the pre-registered study): S5 MA cross, S8 squeeze break, S4 coil break, BTCUSDT or ETHUSDT: EXPLORATORY desk try, not the pre-registered study krown-dev-event-study, NO-RECALL-CLEARANCE. BTC / USDT, 4 hours Krown S5: 21/55 EMA cross on the 200 side: market entry at the next bar's open, stop past the last 10 bars, a target at 2 x risk, closed after 100 bars; fees 0.02 % limit / 0.05 % market, plus 0.02 % slippage on market and stop fills; 2022-04-01 to 2024-06-30 (development window only). Skipped detectors: S1 zone test, S2 zone break and S7 capitulation need volume (the desk bars have none; the trader quotes CME volume); S9 tops need volume; S3 range edge needs candle-pattern wicks (all OURS); S6 leash fires at the reconnect bar, after the move, and names no entry direction (provisional, one video).
what.label: OURS

how: Run on the local simulator desk: the study re-simulates every idea on development data; the optional condition then keeps only matching trades (post-filter on the cached run). Fees are included; a never-filled idea is not a trade.
window: DEV only, 2022-04-01 to 2024-06-30 (VALIDATION and HOLDOUT never offered)
why: 95 % range of the average -0.161 to +0.750 R: too wide to call either way; 35 trades can only rule out edges above about +0.64 R

examples.title: Running total of net R, filled trades in time order
